name: Combination Discipline — Call the Wild Hunt

system.description:
Prerequisites: Animalism 5, Protean 4. In ancient days, when the Gangrel rode openly across the steppes, this power saw far greater use. It allows a vampire to transform her ghouls into a Wild Hunt — a pack of feral animals that runs with her, tearing apart anything in their path. In the process, the vampire transfers a portion of her Beast into her followers, making it harder for her to succumb to frenzy while they give themselves over entirely to blood rage.

System: The vampire need not be near frenzy to use this power, but her ghouls must be able to see her when it activates. The player rolls Manipulation + Animal Ken (difficulty 6), with each success affecting one ghoul (human or animal). Failure forces a frenzy check (difficulty 7); a botch means automatic frenzy. Affected ghouls fall into frenzy with all its usual benefits, but will not attack each other or their regnant, and each immediately manifests Talons of the Beast (Protean 2), spending a blood point from their own pool to do so. The controlling vampire becomes immune to frenzy and Rötschreck for the duration. The Wild Hunt ends at dawn.

Costs 20 Experience Traits to learn.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book One: Animals
